title: Learn English with Podcast | A Story That Changes How You Think | A2 Listening & Shadowing Practice

segments.text: There was once a king who wanted to live wisely.
segments.ipa: /ðɛr wɑz wʌns ə kɪŋ hu ˈwɔntɪd tu laɪv ˈwaɪzli/

segments.text: He had great power.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd ɡreɪt ˈpaʊər/

segments.text: He had many people working for him.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd ˈmɛni ˈpipəl ˈwɝkɪŋ fɔr hɪm/

segments.text: He had soldiers, servants, teachers, and advisors.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd ˈsoʊldʒərz ˈsɝvənts ˈtitʃərz ənd ædˈvaɪzərz/

segments.text: The king wanted to make good decisions, but he often worried that he might choose the wrong thing.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˈwɔntɪd tu meɪk ɡʊd dɪˈsɪʒənz bʌt hi ˈɔfən ˈwɝid ðæt hi maɪt tʃuz ðə rɔŋ θɪŋ/

segments.text: He started thinking about one important idea.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈstɑrtɪd ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt wʌn ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt aɪˈdiə/

segments.text: He believed that if he knew the answers to three questions, he would never make a serious mistake.
segments.ipa: /hi bɪˈlivd ðæt ɪf hi nu ðə ˈænsərz tu θri ˈkwɛstʃənz hi wʊd ˈnɛvər meɪk ə ˈsɪriəs mɪˈsteɪk/

segments.text: The first question was about time.
segments.ipa: /ðə fɝst ˈkwɛstʃən wɑz əˈbaʊt taɪm/

segments.text: He wanted to know the best time to begin something.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd tu noʊ ðə bɛst taɪm tu bɪˈɡɪn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/

segments.text: The second question was about people.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈkwɛstʃən wɑz əˈbaʊt ˈpipəl/

segments.text: He wanted to know which people were the most important people to listen to.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd tu noʊ wɪtʃ ˈpipəl wɝ ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈpipəl tu ˈlɪsən tu/

segments.text: The third question was about action.
segments.ipa: /ðə θɝd ˈkwɛstʃən wɑz əˈbaʊt ˈækʃən/

segments.text: He wanted to know what the most important thing was to do.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd tu noʊ wʌt ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt θɪŋ wɑz tu du/

segments.text: The king thought that these three answers could help him live a perfect life.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ θɔt ðæt ðiz θri ˈænsərz kʊd hɛlp hɪm laɪv ə pərˈfɛkt laɪf/

segments.text: If he always knew the right time, he would never act too early or too late.
segments.ipa: /ɪf hi ˈɔlˌweɪz nu ðə raɪt taɪm hi wʊd ˈnɛvər ækt tu ˈɝli ɔr tu leɪt/

segments.text: If he always knew the right people, he would never listen to the wrong person.
segments.ipa: /ɪf hi ˈɔlˌweɪz nu ðə raɪt ˈpipəl hi wʊd ˈnɛvər ˈlɪsən tu ðə rɔŋ ˈpɝsən/

segments.text: If he always knew the right action, he would never waste his time on something unimportant.
segments.ipa: /ɪf hi ˈɔlˌweɪz nu ðə raɪt ˈækʃən hi wʊd ˈnɛvər weɪst hɪz taɪm ɑn ˈsʌmθɪŋ ənɪmˈpɔrtənt/

segments.text: The king decided to find the answers.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd tu faɪnd ðə ˈænsərz/

segments.text: He sent a message across his kingdom.
segments.ipa: /hi sɛnt ə ˈmɛsədʒ əˈkrɔs hɪz ˈkɪŋdəm/

segments.text: He promised a less reward to anyone who could answer the three questions correctly.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈprɑməst ə lɛs rɪˈwɔrd tu ˈɛniˌwʌn hu kʊd ˈænsər ðə θri ˈkwɛstʃənz kərˈɛktli/

segments.text: Soon many people came to the palace.
segments.ipa: /sun ˈmɛni ˈpipəl keɪm tu ðə ˈpæləs/

segments.text: Some were teachers, some were religious men, some were soldiers, some were doctors, some were advisers,
segments.ipa: /sʌm wɝ ˈtitʃərz sʌm wɝ rɪˈlɪdʒəs mɛn sʌm wɝ ˈsoʊldʒərz sʌm wɝ ˈdɑktərz sʌm wɝ ædˈvaɪzərz/

segments.text: some were rich people, and some were ordinary people.
segments.ipa: /sʌm wɝ rɪtʃ ˈpipəl ənd sʌm wɝ ˈɔrdəˌnɛri ˈpipəl/

segments.text: Each person believed that they knew the correct answer.
segments.ipa: /itʃ ˈpɝsən bɪˈlivd ðæt ðeɪ nu ðə kərˈɛkt ˈænsər/

segments.text: The king listened carefully to all of them, but the answers were very different.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˈlɪsənd ˈkɛrfəli tu ɔl ʌv ðɛm bʌt ðə ˈænsərz wɝ ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt/

segments.text: For the first question, some people said that the king should make a clear plan for every day,
segments.ipa: /fɔr ðə fɝst ˈkwɛstʃən sʌm ˈpipəl sɛd ðæt ðə kɪŋ ʃʊd meɪk ə klɪr plæn fɔr ˈɛvəri deɪ/

segments.text: every month, and every year.
segments.ipa: /ˈɛvəri mʌnθ ənd ˈɛvəri jɪr/

segments.text: They believed that if he planned everything carefully, he would always know the best time to act.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ bɪˈlivd ðæt ɪf hi plænd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˈkɛrfəli hi wʊd ˈɔlˌweɪz noʊ ðə bɛst taɪm tu ækt/

segments.text: Other people did not agree.
segments.ipa: /ˈʌðər ˈpipəl dɪd nɑt əˈɡri/

segments.text: They believed that it was impossible to plan everything.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ bɪˈlivd ðæt ɪt wɑz ˌɪmˈpɑsəbəl tu plæn ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/

segments.text: Life could change suddenly.
segments.ipa: /laɪf kʊd tʃeɪndʒ ˈsʌdənli/

segments.text: Something unexpected could happen at any moment.
segments.ipa: /ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˌʌnɪkˈspɛktɪd kʊd ˈhæpən æt ˈɛni ˈmoʊmənt/

segments.text: They thought the king should watch what was happening around him and then decide what to do.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ θɔt ðə kɪŋ ʃʊd wɑtʃ wʌt wɑz ˈhæpənɪŋ ərˈaʊnd hɪm ənd ðɛn ˌdɪˈsaɪd wʌt tu du/

segments.text: Some people said that the king should ask wise advisors before making an important decision.
segments.ipa: /sʌm ˈpipəl sɛd ðæt ðə kɪŋ ʃʊd æsk waɪz ædˈvaɪzərz bɪˈfɔr ˈmeɪkɪŋ æn ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt dɪˈsɪʒən/

segments.text: They believed that one person could never understand everything alone.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ bɪˈlivd ðæt wʌn ˈpɝsən kʊd ˈnɛvər ˌʌndərˈstænd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ əˈloʊn/

segments.text: Other people said that waiting for advisers could sometimes be dangerous.
segments.ipa: /ˈʌðər ˈpipəl sɛd ðæt ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr ædˈvaɪzərz kʊd səmˈtaɪmz bi ˈdeɪndʒərəs/

segments.text: There were moments when a decision had to be made immediately.
segments.ipa: /ðɛr wɝ ˈmoʊmənts wɛn ə dɪˈsɪʒən hæd tu bi meɪd ˌɪˈmiˌdiətli/

segments.text: The king listened to every answer but he did not feel satisfied.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˈlɪsənd tu ˈɛvəri ˈænsər bʌt hi dɪd nɑt fil ˈsætəsˌfaɪd/

segments.text: Then he asked about the second question.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn hi æskt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈkwɛstʃən/

segments.text: He wanted to know which people were the most important people in his life.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd tu noʊ wɪtʃ ˈpipəl wɝ ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈpipəl ɪn hɪz laɪf/

segments.text: Again the answers were different.
segments.ipa: /əˈɡɛn ðə ˈænsərz wɝ ˈdɪfərənt/

segments.text: Some people said that the king's advisors were the most important.
segments.ipa: /sʌm ˈpipəl sɛd ðæt ðə kɪŋz ædˈvaɪzərz wɝ ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt/

segments.text: They helped him make decisions about the kingdom.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ hɛlpt hɪm meɪk dɪˈsɪʒənz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkɪŋdəm/

segments.text: Others said that religious leaders were the most important because they could guide him in questions about life and goodness.
segments.ipa: /ˈʌðərz sɛd ðæt rɪˈlɪdʒəs ˈlidərz wɝ ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt bɪˈkɔz ðeɪ kʊd ɡaɪd hɪm ɪn ˈkwɛstʃənz əˈbaʊt laɪf ənd ˈɡʊdnəs/

segments.text: Some people said that doctors were the most important because health was more important than everything else.
segments.ipa: /sʌm ˈpipəl sɛd ðæt ˈdɑktərz wɝ ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt bɪˈkɔz hɛlθ wɑz mɔr ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ðæn ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɛls/

segments.text: Others believed that soldiers were the most important because they protected the king and the country.
segments.ipa: /ˈʌðərz bɪˈlivd ðæt ˈsoʊldʒərz wɝ ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt bɪˈkɔz ðeɪ prəˈtɛktɪd ðə kɪŋ ənd ðə ˈkʌntri/

segments.text: Each answer seemed possible, but none of them felt completely correct.
segments.ipa: /itʃ ˈænsər simd ˈpɑsəbəl bʌt nʌn ʌv ðɛm fɛlt kəmˈplitli kərˈɛkt/

segments.text: Then the king asked about the third question.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn ðə kɪŋ æskt əˈbaʊt ðə θɝd ˈkwɛstʃən/

segments.text: He wanted to know the most important thing a person could do.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd tu noʊ ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt θɪŋ ə ˈpɝsən kʊd du/

segments.text: Some people said that learning was the most important thing.
segments.ipa: /sʌm ˈpipəl sɛd ðæt ˈlɝnɪŋ wɑz ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt θɪŋ/

segments.text: Some said religion.
segments.ipa: /sʌm sɛd rɪˈlɪdʒən/

segments.text: Some said protecting the country.
segments.ipa: /sʌm sɛd prəˈtɛktɪŋ ðə ˈkʌntri/

segments.text: Some said helping people.
segments.ipa: /sʌm sɛd ˈhɛlpɪŋ ˈpipəl/

segments.text: Some said becoming strong.
segments.ipa: /sʌm sɛd bɪˈkʌmɪŋ strɔŋ/

segments.text: Some said making good laws.
segments.ipa: /sʌm sɛd ˈmeɪkɪŋ ɡʊd lɔz/

segments.text: Some said becoming rich.
segments.ipa: /sʌm sɛd bɪˈkʌmɪŋ rɪtʃ/

segments.text: Some said living peacefully. Again.
segments.ipa: /sʌm sɛd ˈlɪvɪŋ ˈpisfəli əˈɡɛn/

segments.text: The king heard many ideas but still he did not find the answer he wanted.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ hɝd ˈmɛni aɪˈdiəz bʌt stɪl hi dɪd nɑt faɪnd ðə ˈænsər hi ˈwɔntɪd/

segments.text: He did not give the reward to anyone.
segments.ipa: /hi dɪd nɑt ɡɪv ðə rɪˈwɔrd tu ˈɛniˌwʌn/

segments.text: The king continued thinking about the three questions.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ kənˈtɪnjud ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə θri ˈkwɛstʃənz/

segments.text: Then he heard about a wise old man who lived alone in a forest.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn hi hɝd əˈbaʊt ə waɪz oʊld mæn hu lɪvd əˈloʊn ɪn ə ˈfɔrəst/

segments.text: People said that this man understood life very deeply.
segments.ipa: /ˈpipəl sɛd ðæt ðɪs mæn ˌʌndərˈstʊd laɪf ˈvɛri ˈdipli/

segments.text: He did not live in a palace.
segments.ipa: /hi dɪd nɑt laɪv ɪn ə ˈpæləs/

segments.text: He did not wear beautiful clothes.
segments.ipa: /hi dɪd nɑt wɛr ˈbjutəfəl kloʊðz/

segments.text: He did not want money or power.
segments.ipa: /hi dɪd nɑt wɑnt ˈmʌni ɔr ˈpaʊər/

segments.text: He lived simply in a small house far from the city.
segments.ipa: /hi lɪvd ˈsɪmpli ɪn ə smɔl haʊs fɑr frʌm ðə ˈsɪti/

segments.text: Many people respected him.
segments.ipa: /ˈmɛni ˈpipəl rɪˈspɛktɪd hɪm/

segments.text: The king became interested.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ bɪˈkeɪm ˈɪntrəstɪd/

segments.text: He decided to visit the old man.
segments.ipa: /hi ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd tu ˈvɪzɪt ðə oʊld mæn/

segments.text: But he knew that the old man usually met only ordinary people.
segments.ipa: /bʌt hi nu ðæt ðə oʊld mæn ˈjuʒəwəli mɛt ˈoʊnli ˈɔrdəˌnɛri ˈpipəl/

segments.text: The king did not want to arrive with soldiers and expensive clothes, so he changed into simple clothes.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ dɪd nɑt wɑnt tu ərˈaɪv wɪð ˈsoʊldʒərz ənd ɪkˈspɛnsɪv kloʊðz soʊ hi tʃeɪndʒd ˈɪntu ˈsɪmpəl kloʊðz/

segments.text: He left his horse and his guards some distance away.
segments.ipa: /hi lɛft hɪz hɔrs ənd hɪz ɡɑrdz sʌm ˈdɪstəns əˈweɪ/

segments.text: Then he walked alone toward the old man's home.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn hi wɔkt əˈloʊn təˈwɔrd ðə oʊld mænz hoʊm/

segments.text: After walking through the forest for some time, the king found the small house.
segments.ipa: /ˈæftər ˈwɔkɪŋ θru ðə ˈfɔrəst fɔr sʌm taɪm ðə kɪŋ faʊnd ðə smɔl haʊs/

segments.text: The old man was outside.
segments.ipa: /ðə oʊld mæn wɑz ˈaʊtˈsaɪd/

segments.text: He was working in a garden.
segments.ipa: /hi wɑz ˈwɝkɪŋ ɪn ə ˈɡɑrdən/

segments.text: He was digging the earth.
segments.ipa: /hi wɑz ˈdɪɡɪŋ ðə ɝθ/

segments.text: The old man was thin and weak.
segments.ipa: /ðə oʊld mæn wɑz θɪn ənd wik/

segments.text: He looked tired.
segments.ipa: /hi lʊkt ˈtaɪərd/

segments.text: Every time he pushed the tool into the ground, he had to stop and rest.
segments.ipa: /ˈɛvəri taɪm hi pʊʃt ðə tul ˈɪntu ðə ɡraʊnd hi hæd tu stɑp ənd rɛst/

segments.text: The king came closer.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ keɪm ˈkloʊsər/

segments.text: He explained why he had come.
segments.ipa: /hi ɪkˈspleɪnd waɪ hi hæd kʌm/

segments.text: He wanted answers to the three questions that had been troubling him.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd ˈænsərz tu ðə θri ˈkwɛstʃənz ðæt hæd bɪn ˈtrʌbəlɪŋ hɪm/

segments.text: He wanted to know the right time for every action.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd tu noʊ ðə raɪt taɪm fɔr ˈɛvəri ˈækʃən/

segments.text: He wanted to know the most important people and he wanted to know the most important thing to do.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd tu noʊ ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈpipəl ənd hi ˈwɔntɪd tu noʊ ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt θɪŋ tu du/

segments.text: The old man listened, but he did not answer.
segments.ipa: /ðə oʊld mæn ˈlɪsənd bʌt hi dɪd nɑt ˈænsər/

segments.text: He continued digging.
segments.ipa: /hi kənˈtɪnjud ˈdɪɡɪŋ/

segments.text: The king waited.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˈweɪtɪd/

segments.text: The old man kept working slowly.
segments.ipa: /ðə oʊld mæn kɛpt ˈwɝkɪŋ ˈsloʊli/

segments.text: After some time, the king noticed 37 that the old man was becoming very tired.
segments.ipa: /ˈæftər sʌm taɪm ðə kɪŋ ˈnoʊtəst ðæt ðə oʊld mæn wɑz bɪˈkʌmɪŋ ˈvɛri ˈtaɪərd/

segments.text: The work was difficult for him.
segments.ipa: /ðə wɝk wɑz ˈdɪfəkəlt fɔr hɪm/

segments.text: The king decided to help.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd tu hɛlp/

segments.text: He took the tool from the old man and began digging.
segments.ipa: /hi tʊk ðə tul frʌm ðə oʊld mæn ənd bɪˈɡæn ˈdɪɡɪŋ/

segments.text: The old man sat down nearby.
segments.ipa: /ðə oʊld mæn sæt daʊn ˈnɪrˈbaɪ/

segments.text: The king worked for a long time.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ wɝkt fɔr ə lɔŋ taɪm/

segments.text: He dug one part of the garden and then another.
segments.ipa: /hi dʌɡ wʌn pɑrt ʌv ðə ˈɡɑrdən ənd ðɛn əˈnʌðər/

segments.text: The sun moved slowly across the sky.
segments.ipa: /ðə sʌn muvd ˈsloʊli əˈkrɔs ðə skaɪ/

segments.text: The king became tired too.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ bɪˈkeɪm ˈtaɪərd tu/

segments.text: Still, the old man did not answer the questions.
segments.ipa: /stɪl ðə oʊld mæn dɪd nɑt ˈænsər ðə ˈkwɛstʃənz/

segments.text: After some time, the king stopped.
segments.ipa: /ˈæftər sʌm taɪm ðə kɪŋ stɑpt/

segments.text: He was beginning to lose patience.
segments.ipa: /hi wɑz bɪˈɡɪnɪŋ tu luz ˈpeɪʃəns/

segments.text: He had traveled a long way.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd ˈtrævəld ə lɔŋ weɪ/

segments.text: He had come because people said that this old man was wise.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd kʌm bɪˈkɔz ˈpipəl sɛd ðæt ðɪs oʊld mæn wɑz waɪz/

segments.text: But the old man had said nothing.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ðə oʊld mæn hæd sɛd ˈnʌθɪŋ/

segments.text: The king decided that he would ask one final time.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd ðæt hi wʊd æsk wʌn ˈfaɪnəl taɪm/

segments.text: But before he could leave, descended.
segments.ipa: /bʌt bɪˈfɔr hi kʊd liv dɪˈsɛndəd/

segments.text: A man suddenly came running out of the forest.
segments.ipa: /ə mæn ˈsʌdənli keɪm ˈrʌnɪŋ aʊt ʌv ðə ˈfɔrəst/

segments.text: He was holding his stomach.
segments.ipa: /hi wɑz ˈhoʊldɪŋ hɪz ˈstʌmək/

segments.text: Blood was coming through his clothes.
segments.ipa: /blʌd wɑz ˈkʌmɪŋ θru hɪz kloʊðz/

segments.text: He looked weak and frightened.
segments.ipa: /hi lʊkt wik ənd ˈfraɪtənd/

segments.text: After taking a few more steps, the man fell to the ground.
segments.ipa: /ˈæftər ˈteɪkɪŋ ə fju mɔr stɛps ðə mæn fɛl tu ðə ɡraʊnd/

segments.text: The king and the old man quickly went to him.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ənd ðə oʊld mæn ˈkwɪkli wɛnt tu hɪm/

segments.text: They saw that he had a deep wound.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ sɔ ðæt hi hæd ə dip waʊnd/

segments.text: The king forgot about his questions.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ fərˈɡɑt əˈbaʊt hɪz ˈkwɛstʃənz/

segments.text: He forgot about his tiredness.
segments.ipa: /hi fərˈɡɑt əˈbaʊt hɪz ˈtaɪərdnɪs/

segments.text: He immediately began helping the injured man.
segments.ipa: /hi ˌɪˈmiˌdiətli bɪˈɡæn ˈhɛlpɪŋ ðə ˈɪndʒərd mæn/

segments.text: He cleaned the wound as well as he could.
segments.ipa: /hi klind ðə waʊnd æz wɛl æz hi kʊd/

segments.text: He used part of his own clothing to stop the bleeding, but the blood continued.
segments.ipa: /hi juzd pɑrt ʌv hɪz oʊn ˈkloʊðɪŋ tu stɑp ðə ˈblidɪŋ bʌt ðə blʌd kənˈtɪnjud/

segments.text: The king cleaned the wound again.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ klind ðə waʊnd əˈɡɛn/

segments.text: Then he changed the cloth.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn hi tʃeɪndʒd ðə klɔθ/

segments.text: Again, the cloth became wet with blood.
segments.ipa: /əˈɡɛn ðə klɔθ bɪˈkeɪm wɛt wɪð blʌd/

segments.text: The king continued working.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ kənˈtɪnjud ˈwɝkɪŋ/

segments.text: He did not stop.
segments.ipa: /hi dɪd nɑt stɑp/

segments.text: He stayed beside the injured man for a long time.
segments.ipa: /hi steɪd bɪˈsaɪd ðə ˈɪndʒərd mæn fɔr ə lɔŋ taɪm/

segments.text: Finally, the bleeding became slower.
segments.ipa: /ˈfaɪnəli ðə ˈblidɪŋ bɪˈkeɪm ˈsloʊər/

segments.text: The wounded man was still alive.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈwundɪd mæn wɑz stɪl əˈlaɪv/

segments.text: The king gave him some water.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ɡeɪv hɪm sʌm ˈwɔtər/

segments.text: Then the king and the old man carried him into the small house.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn ðə kɪŋ ənd ðə oʊld mæn ˈkærid hɪm ˈɪntu ðə smɔl haʊs/

segments.text: They put him on a bed.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ pʊt hɪm ɑn ə bɛd/

segments.text: By this time, night was coming.
segments.ipa: /baɪ ðɪs taɪm naɪt wɑz ˈkʌmɪŋ/

segments.text: The king was completely exhausted.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ wɑz kəmˈplitli ɪɡˈzɔstɪd/

segments.text: He had spent much of the day digging.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd spɛnt mʌtʃ ʌv ðə deɪ ˈdɪɡɪŋ/

segments.text: Then he had worked hard to save the wounded man.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn hi hæd wɝkt hɑrd tu seɪv ðə ˈwundɪd mæn/

segments.text: He sat down near the door.
segments.ipa: /hi sæt daʊn nɪr ðə dɔr/

segments.text: Soon he fell asleep.
segments.ipa: /sun hi fɛl əˈslip/

segments.text: He slept deeply.
segments.ipa: /hi slɛpt ˈdipli/

segments.text: When he woke the next morning, sunlight was entering the room.
segments.ipa: /wɛn hi woʊk ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈsʌnˌlaɪt wɑz ˈɛntərɪŋ ðə rum/

segments.text: For a few moments, the king did not remember where he was.
segments.ipa: /fɔr ə fju ˈmoʊmənts ðə kɪŋ dɪd nɑt rɪˈmɛmbər wɛr hi wɑz/

segments.text: Then he saw the wounded man.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn hi sɔ ðə ˈwundɪd mæn/

segments.text: The man was awake.
segments.ipa: /ðə mæn wɑz əˈweɪk/

segments.text: He was looking at the king.
segments.ipa: /hi wɑz ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ðə kɪŋ/

segments.text: There was something strange in his expression.
segments.ipa: /ðɛr wɑz ˈsʌmθɪŋ streɪndʒ ɪn hɪz ɪkˈsprɛʃən/

segments.text: He looked sorry.
segments.ipa: /hi lʊkt ˈsɑri/

segments.text: He looked ashamed.
segments.ipa: /hi lʊkt əˈʃeɪmd/

segments.text: The king did not understand.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ dɪd nɑt ˌʌndərˈstænd/

segments.text: The wounded man then explained what had happened.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈwundɪd mæn ðɛn ɪkˈspleɪnd wʌt hæd ˈhæpənd/

segments.text: The king learned that this man had not come to the forest by accident.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ lɝnd ðæt ðɪs mæn hæd nɑt kʌm tu ðə ˈfɔrəst baɪ ˈæksədənt/

segments.text: He had come because he hated the king.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd kʌm bɪˈkɔz hi ˈheɪtəd ðə kɪŋ/

segments.text: Sometime earlier, the king had punished the man's brother.
segments.ipa: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪm ˈɝliər ðə kɪŋ hæd ˈpʌnɪʃt ðə mænz ˈbrʌðər/

segments.text: The king had also taken some of the family's land.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ hæd ˈɔlsoʊ ˈteɪkən sʌm ʌv ðə ˈfæməliz lænd/

segments.text: The man had never forgotten this.
segments.ipa: /ðə mæn hæd ˈnɛvər fərˈɡɑtən ðɪs/

segments.text: He wanted revenge.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd riˈvɛndʒ/

segments.text: When he heard that the king was going to visit the wise old man alone,
segments.ipa: /wɛn hi hɝd ðæt ðə kɪŋ wɑz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ˈvɪzɪt ðə waɪz oʊld mæn əˈloʊn/

segments.text: he decided to follow him.
segments.ipa: /hi ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd tu ˈfɑloʊ hɪm/

segments.text: He planned to wait near the road.
segments.ipa: /hi plænd tu weɪt nɪr ðə roʊd/

segments.text: He wanted to attack the king when the king returned.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd tu əˈtæk ðə kɪŋ wɛn ðə kɪŋ rɪˈtɝnd/

segments.text: But the king stayed with the old man much longer than expected.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ðə kɪŋ steɪd wɪð ðə oʊld mæn mʌtʃ ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn ɪkˈspɛktəd/

segments.text: The man waited and waited.
segments.ipa: /ðə mæn ˈweɪtɪd ənd ˈweɪtɪd/

segments.text: Finally, he came out of his hiding place.
segments.ipa: /ˈfaɪnəli hi keɪm aʊt ʌv hɪz ˈhaɪdɪŋ pleɪs/

segments.text: The king's guards saw him.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋz ɡɑrdz sɔ hɪm/

segments.text: They recognized him as an enemy.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ ˈrɛkəɡˌnaɪzd hɪm æz æn ˈɛnəmi/

segments.text: They attacked him.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ əˈtækt hɪm/

segments.text: The man was badly wounded, but he escaped.
segments.ipa: /ðə mæn wɑz ˈbædli ˈwundɪd bʌt hi ɪˈskeɪpt/

segments.text: He ran through the forest.
segments.ipa: /hi ræn θru ðə ˈfɔrəst/

segments.text: Then he reached the old man's house.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn hi ritʃt ðə oʊld mænz haʊs/

segments.text: He expected to find his enemy.
segments.ipa: /hi ɪkˈspɛktəd tu faɪnd hɪz ˈɛnəmi/

segments.text: Instead, his enemy saved his life.
segments.ipa: /ˌɪnˈstɛd hɪz ˈɛnəmi seɪvd hɪz laɪf/

segments.text: The king had cleaned his wound.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ hæd klind hɪz waʊnd/

segments.text: The king had stopped his bleeding.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ hæd stɑpt hɪz ˈblidɪŋ/

segments.text: The king had carried him to safety.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ hæd ˈkærid hɪm tu ˈseɪfti/

segments.text: The king had stayed beside him.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ hæd steɪd bɪˈsaɪd hɪm/

segments.text: The wounded man was deeply moved.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈwundɪd mæn wɑz ˈdipli muvd/

segments.text: He had come to kill the king.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd kʌm tu kɪl ðə kɪŋ/

segments.text: Now the king had saved him.
segments.ipa: /naʊ ðə kɪŋ hæd seɪvd hɪm/

segments.text: The man no longer wanted revenge.
segments.ipa: /ðə mæn noʊ ˈlɔŋɡər ˈwɔntɪd riˈvɛndʒ/

segments.text: He felt terrible about his plan.
segments.ipa: /hi fɛlt ˈtɛrəbəl əˈbaʊt hɪz plæn/

segments.text: He promised that if he lived, he would serve the king faithfully.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈprɑməst ðæt ɪf hi lɪvd hi wʊd sɝv ðə kɪŋ ˈfeɪθfəli/

segments.text: He also promised that his family would respect the king.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈɔlsoʊ ˈprɑməst ðæt hɪz ˈfæməli wʊd rɪˈspɛkt ðə kɪŋ/

segments.text: The king listened.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˈlɪsənd/

segments.text: He was surprised by everything he had learned.
segments.ipa: /hi wɑz sərˈpraɪzd baɪ ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ hi hæd lɝnd/

segments.text: He had come to the forest hoping to find wisdom.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd kʌm tu ðə ˈfɔrəst ˈhoʊpɪŋ tu faɪnd ˈwɪzdəm/

segments.text: Instead, he had found an enemy.
segments.ipa: /ˌɪnˈstɛd hi hæd faʊnd æn ˈɛnəmi/

segments.text: But something important had changed.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt hæd tʃeɪndʒd/

segments.text: A man who had hated him was no longer his enemy.
segments.ipa: /ə mæn hu hæd ˈheɪtəd hɪm wɑz noʊ ˈlɔŋɡər hɪz ˈɛnəmi/

segments.text: The king decided to forgive him.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd tu fərˈɡɪv hɪm/

segments.text: He also promised to return the man's land.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈɔlsoʊ ˈprɑməst tu rɪˈtɝn ðə mænz lænd/

segments.text: He said that he would send a doctor and servants to take care of him.
segments.ipa: /hi sɛd ðæt hi wʊd sɛnd ə ˈdɑktər ənd ˈsɝvənts tu teɪk kɛr ʌv hɪm/

segments.text: The king felt peaceful.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ fɛlt ˈpisfəl/

segments.text: He was happy that the hatred between them had ended, but he still remembered his three questions.
segments.ipa: /hi wɑz ˈhæpi ðæt ðə ˈheɪtrəd bɪˈtwin ðɛm hæd ˈɛndəd bʌt hi stɪl rɪˈmɛmbərd hɪz θri ˈkwɛstʃənz/

segments.text: He went outside.
segments.ipa: /hi wɛnt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd/

segments.text: The old man was in the garden again.
segments.ipa: /ðə oʊld mæn wɑz ɪn ðə ˈɡɑrdən əˈɡɛn/

segments.text: He was planting seeds in the earth that the king had dug the day before.
segments.ipa: /hi wɑz ˈplæntɪŋ sidz ɪn ðə ɝθ ðæt ðə kɪŋ hæd dʌɡ ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔr/

segments.text: The king approached him.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ əˈproʊtʃt hɪm/

segments.text: He wanted to ask for the answers one last time.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd tu æsk fɔr ðə ˈænsərz wʌn læst taɪm/

segments.text: He felt that he had been patient.
segments.ipa: /hi fɛlt ðæt hi hæd bɪn ˈpeɪʃənt/

segments.text: He had helped the old man.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd hɛlpt ðə oʊld mæn/

segments.text: He had stayed all night.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd steɪd ɔl naɪt/

segments.text: He had saved a wounded man.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd seɪvd ə ˈwundɪd mæn/

segments.text: But he still believed that his three questions had not been answered.
segments.ipa: /bʌt hi stɪl bɪˈlivd ðæt hɪz θri ˈkwɛstʃənz hæd nɑt bɪn ˈænsərd/

segments.text: The old man looked at him.
segments.ipa: /ðə oʊld mæn lʊkt æt hɪm/

segments.text: Then he explained that the king had already received his answers.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn hi ɪkˈspleɪnd ðæt ðə kɪŋ hæd ɔlˈrɛdi rəˈsivd hɪz ˈænsərz/

segments.text: The king was confused.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ wɑz kənfˈjuzd/

segments.text: He thought back over everything that had happened.
segments.ipa: /hi θɔt bæk ˈoʊvər ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ðæt hæd ˈhæpənd/

segments.text: The old man helped him understand.
segments.ipa: /ðə oʊld mæn hɛlpt hɪm ˌʌndərˈstænd/

segments.text: The day before, when the king first arrived, the old man was digging.
segments.ipa: /ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔr wɛn ðə kɪŋ fɝst ərˈaɪvd ðə oʊld mæn wɑz ˈdɪɡɪŋ/

segments.text: The king saw that he was weak.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ sɔ ðæt hi wɑz wik/

segments.text: The king decided to stay and help him.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd tu steɪ ənd hɛlp hɪm/

segments.text: That moment was more important than the king understood.
segments.ipa: /ðæt ˈmoʊmənt wɑz mɔr ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ðæn ðə kɪŋ ˌʌndərˈstʊd/

segments.text: If the king had not stayed to help, he would have left earlier.
segments.ipa: /ɪf ðə kɪŋ hæd nɑt steɪd tu hɛlp hi wʊd hæv lɛft ˈɝliər/

segments.text: If he had left earlier, the angry man hiding in the forest might have attacked him.
segments.ipa: /ɪf hi hæd lɛft ˈɝliər ðə ˈæŋɡri mæn ˈhaɪdɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈfɔrəst maɪt hæv əˈtækt hɪm/

segments.text: The king could have been badly hurt or even killed.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ kʊd hæv bɪn ˈbædli hɝt ɔr ˈivɪn kɪld/

segments.text: Because the king stayed in the garden, his life was saved.
segments.ipa: /bɪˈkɔz ðə kɪŋ steɪd ɪn ðə ˈɡɑrdən hɪz laɪf wɑz seɪvd/

segments.text: At that time, the most important moment was the moment he was living in.
segments.ipa: /æt ðæt taɪm ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈmoʊmənt wɑz ðə ˈmoʊmənt hi wɑz ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn/

segments.text: The most important person was the old man beside him and the most important action was helping the old man.
segments.ipa: /ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈpɝsən wɑz ðə oʊld mæn bɪˈsaɪd hɪm ənd ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈækʃən wɑz ˈhɛlpɪŋ ðə oʊld mæn/

segments.text: Later the wounded man arrived.
segments.ipa: /ˈleɪtər ðə ˈwundɪd mæn ərˈaɪvd/

segments.text: At that moment everything changed.
segments.ipa: /æt ðæt ˈmoʊmənt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ tʃeɪndʒd/

segments.text: The wounded man became the most important person.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈwundɪd mæn bɪˈkeɪm ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈpɝsən/

segments.text: The most important action became saving his life.
segments.ipa: /ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈækʃən bɪˈkeɪm ˈseɪvɪŋ hɪz laɪf/

segments.text: If the king had decided that his questions were more important than the injured man,
segments.ipa: /ɪf ðə kɪŋ hæd ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd ðæt hɪz ˈkwɛstʃənz wɝ mɔr ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ðæn ðə ˈɪndʒərd mæn/

segments.text: the man could have died.
segments.ipa: /ðə mæn kʊd hæv daɪd/

segments.text: The king would also have lost the chance to make peace with someone who hated him.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ wʊd ˈɔlsoʊ hæv lɔst ðə tʃæns tu meɪk pis wɪð ˈsʌmˌwʌn hu ˈheɪtəd hɪm/

segments.text: The king slowly began to understand.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˈsloʊli bɪˈɡæn tu ˌʌndərˈstænd/

segments.text: His questions had not needed complicated answers.
segments.ipa: /hɪz ˈkwɛstʃənz hæd nɑt ˈnidəd ˈkɑmpləˌkeɪtəd ˈænsərz/

segments.text: He had been looking for rules that could control the future.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd bɪn ˈlʊkɪŋ fɔr rulz ðæt kʊd kənˈtroʊl ðə ˈfjutʃər/

segments.text: But life did not work that way.
segments.ipa: /bʌt laɪf dɪd nɑt wɝk ðæt weɪ/

segments.text: He could not always know what would happen tomorrow.
segments.ipa: /hi kʊd nɑt ˈɔlˌweɪz noʊ wʌt wʊd ˈhæpən təˈmɑˌroʊ/

segments.text: He could not always know what would happen in one hour.
segments.ipa: /hi kʊd nɑt ˈɔlˌweɪz noʊ wʌt wʊd ˈhæpən ɪn wʌn ˈaʊər/

segments.text: He could not know which person would become important later.
segments.ipa: /hi kʊd nɑt noʊ wɪtʃ ˈpɝsən wʊd bɪˈkʌm ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈleɪtər/

segments.text: He could not know which future action would become necessary.
segments.ipa: /hi kʊd nɑt noʊ wɪtʃ ˈfjutʃər ˈækʃən wʊd bɪˈkʌm ˈnɛsəˌsɛri/

segments.text: There was only one time that was truly important.
segments.ipa: /ðɛr wɑz ˈoʊnli wʌn taɪm ðæt wɑz ˈtruli ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt/

segments.text: It was the present moment.
segments.ipa: /ɪt wɑz ðə ˈprɛzənt ˈmoʊmənt/

segments.text: The present was the only time in which a person could act.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈprɛzənt wɑz ðə ˈoʊnli taɪm ɪn wɪtʃ ə ˈpɝsən kʊd ækt/

segments.text: The past was already finished.
segments.ipa: /ðə pæst wɑz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈfɪnɪʃt/

segments.text: The future had not arrived.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈfjutʃər hæd nɑt ərˈaɪvd/

segments.text: A person could remember the past.
segments.ipa: /ə ˈpɝsən kʊd rɪˈmɛmbər ðə pæst/

segments.text: The person could plan for the future.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈpɝsən kʊd plæn fɔr ðə ˈfjutʃər/

segments.text: But a person could only live in the present.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ə ˈpɝsən kʊd ˈoʊnli laɪv ɪn ðə ˈprɛzənt/

segments.text: The king had spent a long time trying to discover the perfect time to act.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ hæd spɛnt ə lɔŋ taɪm ˈtraɪɪŋ tu dɪˈskʌvər ðə pərˈfɛkt taɪm tu ækt/

segments.text: Now he understood that the most important time was always now.
segments.ipa: /naʊ hi ˌʌndərˈstʊd ðæt ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt taɪm wɑz ˈɔlˌweɪz naʊ/

segments.text: Then he understood the second answer.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn hi ˌʌndərˈstʊd ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈænsər/

segments.text: The most important person was the person who was with him at that moment.
segments.ipa: /ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈpɝsən wɑz ðə ˈpɝsən hu wɑz wɪð hɪm æt ðæt ˈmoʊmənt/

segments.text: Sometimes that person might be a king.
segments.ipa: /səmˈtaɪmz ðæt ˈpɝsən maɪt bi ə kɪŋ/

segments.text: Sometimes it might be a servant.
segments.ipa: /səmˈtaɪmz ɪt maɪt bi ə ˈsɝvənt/

segments.text: Sometimes it might be a friend.
segments.ipa: /səmˈtaɪmz ɪt maɪt bi ə frɛnd/

segments.text: Sometimes it might even be an enemy.
segments.ipa: /səmˈtaɪmz ɪt maɪt ˈivɪn bi æn ˈɛnəmi/

segments.text: There was no way to know who would be important later.
segments.ipa: /ðɛr wɑz noʊ weɪ tu noʊ hu wʊd bi ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈleɪtər/

segments.text: The only person he could truly help was the person who was in front of him now.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈoʊnli ˈpɝsən hi kʊd ˈtruli hɛlp wɑz ðə ˈpɝsən hu wɑz ɪn frʌnt ʌv hɪm naʊ/

segments.text: The king had also spent a long time wondering which people he should listen to.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ hæd ˈɔlsoʊ spɛnt ə lɔŋ taɪm ˈwʌndərɪŋ wɪtʃ ˈpipəl hi ʃʊd ˈlɪsən tu/

segments.text: He had thought perhaps advisers were most important, perhaps soldiers, perhaps doctors, perhaps religious teachers.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd θɔt pərˈhæps ædˈvaɪzərz wɝ moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt pərˈhæps ˈsoʊldʒərz pərˈhæps ˈdɑktərz pərˈhæps rɪˈlɪdʒəs ˈtitʃərz/

segments.text: But the answer was simpler.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ðə ˈænsər wɑz ˈsɪmpələr/

segments.text: The person in front of him was the person who mattered most at that moment.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈpɝsən ɪn frʌnt ʌv hɪm wɑz ðə ˈpɝsən hu ˈmætərd moʊst æt ðæt ˈmoʊmənt/

segments.text: Finally, the king understood the third answer.
segments.ipa: /ˈfaɪnəli ðə kɪŋ ˌʌndərˈstʊd ðə θɝd ˈænsər/

segments.text: The most important thing to do was to do good for the person beside him.
segments.ipa: /ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt θɪŋ tu du wɑz tu du ɡʊd fɔr ðə ˈpɝsən bɪˈsaɪd hɪm/

segments.text: He had wanted to know the single most important action in life.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd ˈwɔntɪd tu noʊ ðə ˈsɪŋɡəl moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈækʃən ɪn laɪf/

segments.text: He had imagined that it might be ruling a country, learning, fighting, praying, or making laws.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd ˌɪˈmædʒənd ðæt ɪt maɪt bi ˈrulɪŋ ə ˈkʌntri ˈlɝnɪŋ ˈfaɪtɪŋ ˈpreɪɪŋ ɔr ˈmeɪkɪŋ lɔz/

segments.text: But none of these could be the correct answer for every moment.
segments.ipa: /bʌt nʌn ʌv ðiz kʊd bi ðə kərˈɛkt ˈænsər fɔr ˈɛvəri ˈmoʊmənt/

segments.text: Different moments required different actions.
segments.ipa: /ˈdɪfərənt ˈmoʊmənts riˈkwaɪərd ˈdɪfərənt ˈækʃənz/

segments.text: The important thing was to notice the person in front of him and do what good he could.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt θɪŋ wɑz tu ˈnoʊtəs ðə ˈpɝsən ɪn frʌnt ʌv hɪm ənd du wʌt ɡʊd hi kʊd/

segments.text: The king thought about the previous day when he saw the tired old man helping him was the right thing to do.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ θɔt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈpriviəs deɪ wɛn hi sɔ ðə ˈtaɪərd oʊld mæn ˈhɛlpɪŋ hɪm wɑz ðə raɪt θɪŋ tu du/

segments.text: When the wounded man arrived, saving him was the right thing to do.
segments.ipa: /wɛn ðə ˈwundɪd mæn ərˈaɪvd ˈseɪvɪŋ hɪm wɑz ðə raɪt θɪŋ tu du/

segments.text: Neither action had been part of the king's plan, but both actions became deeply important.
segments.ipa: /ˈniðər ˈækʃən hæd bɪn pɑrt ʌv ðə kɪŋz plæn bʌt boʊθ ˈækʃənz bɪˈkeɪm ˈdipli ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt/

segments.text: The king realized that he had spent too much time thinking about the future.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˈriəˌlaɪzd ðæt hi hæd spɛnt tu mʌtʃ taɪm ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈfjutʃər/

segments.text: He had wanted to know everything before it happened.
segments.ipa: /hi hæd ˈwɔntɪd tu noʊ ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ bɪˈfɔr ɪt ˈhæpənd/

segments.text: He wanted a perfect plan.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd ə pərˈfɛkt plæn/

segments.text: He wanted rules that could protect him from every mistake.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈwɔntɪd rulz ðæt kʊd prəˈtɛkt hɪm frʌm ˈɛvəri mɪˈsteɪk/

segments.text: But no person could have that kind of knowledge.
segments.ipa: /bʌt noʊ ˈpɝsən kʊd hæv ðæt kaɪnd ʌv ˈnɑlədʒ/

segments.text: He still thought about the future, but he did not live only in the future.
segments.ipa: /hi stɪl θɔt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈfjutʃər bʌt hi dɪd nɑt laɪv ˈoʊnli ɪn ðə ˈfjutʃər/

segments.text: He still remembered the past, but he did not allow the past to control every decision.
segments.ipa: /hi stɪl rɪˈmɛmbərd ðə pæst bʌt hi dɪd nɑt əˈlaʊ ðə pæst tu kənˈtroʊl ˈɛvəri dɪˈsɪʒən/

segments.text: He learned to notice what was happening now.
segments.ipa: /hi lɝnd tu ˈnoʊtəs wʌt wɑz ˈhæpənɪŋ naʊ/

segments.text: He remembered the old man in the garden.
segments.ipa: /hi rɪˈmɛmbərd ðə oʊld mæn ɪn ðə ˈɡɑrdən/

segments.text: He remembered the wounded stranger.
segments.ipa: /hi rɪˈmɛmbərd ðə ˈwundɪd ˈstreɪndʒər/

segments.text: He remembered how close danger had been without his knowledge.
segments.ipa: /hi rɪˈmɛmbərd haʊ kloʊs ˈdeɪndʒər hæd bɪn wɪˈθaʊt hɪz ˈnɑlədʒ/

segments.text: And he remembered how simple kindness had changed an enemy into a friend.
segments.ipa: /ənd hi rɪˈmɛmbərd haʊ ˈsɪmpəl ˈkaɪndnəs hæd tʃeɪndʒd æn ˈɛnəmi ˈɪntu ə frɛnd/

segments.text: The king had started his journey because he wanted three perfect answers.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ hæd ˈstɑrtɪd hɪz ˈdʒɝni bɪˈkɔz hi ˈwɔntɪd θri pərˈfɛkt ˈænsərz/

segments.text: He imagined that those answers would give him control over life.
segments.ipa: /hi ˌɪˈmædʒənd ðæt ðoʊz ˈænsərz wʊd ɡɪv hɪm kənˈtroʊl ˈoʊvər laɪf/

segments.text: Instead, he learned something different.
segments.ipa: /ˌɪnˈstɛd hi lɝnd ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈdɪfərənt/

segments.text: Life could not always be controlled, but it could be lived attention.
segments.ipa: /laɪf kʊd nɑt ˈɔlˌweɪz bi kənˈtroʊld bʌt ɪt kʊd bi lɪvd əˈtɛnʃən/

segments.text: The best time was the present moment.
segments.ipa: /ðə bɛst taɪm wɑz ðə ˈprɛzənt ˈmoʊmənt/

segments.text: The most important person was the person beside him.
segments.ipa: /ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈpɝsən wɑz ðə ˈpɝsən bɪˈsaɪd hɪm/

segments.text: And the most important thing was to do good for that person while he had the chance.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðə moʊst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt θɪŋ wɑz tu du ɡʊd fɔr ðæt ˈpɝsən waɪl hi hæd ðə tʃæns/

segments.text: The king never forgot what he had learned in the forest.
segments.ipa: /ðə kɪŋ ˈnɛvər fərˈɡɑt wʌt hi hæd lɝnd ɪn ðə ˈfɔrəst/

segments.text: And from that time on, whenever life became confusing, he returned in his mind to those three simple truths.
segments.ipa: /ənd frʌm ðæt taɪm ɑn wɛˈnɛvər laɪf bɪˈkeɪm kənfˈjuzɪŋ hi rɪˈtɝnd ɪn hɪz maɪnd tu ðoʊz θri ˈsɪmpəl truθs/
